newsitem.title: GREECE: INTRACOM LEADS EU-FUNDED HIGH-TECH PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: INTRACOM LEADS EU-FUNDED HIGH-TECH PROJECT.

text.p: Intracom has been selected to lead a Greek consortium which will develop an EU-funded project for the spread of microelectronics technology among small and medium size companies, it said in a statement.
FUSE (First USER Action) aims to popularise the use of microelectronics in the small business production process to improve the international competitiveness of products.
It is part of the EU's ESPRIT programme which promotes the transfer of microelectronics technology and related know-how to small enterprises.

"The innovation associated with FUSE is that it is materialised through the 'Application Trial' project which is fully funded by the EU, carrying a budget of 25,000 ecu (7.5 million drachmas) to 180,000 ecu (54 million drachmas) per case," Intracom said.
Intracom is the project leader for Greece, while participants include Archimedes Ltd and the Greek universities of Patras and Demokritos at Thrace.
During the first year in which the project has been made available to Greek businesses, some 13 Greek companies have received funding. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
